name: GotechArk Advanced Spam Shield for CF7
author: TechArk Solutions

sections.description:
CF7 Advanced Spam Shield automatically adds spam protection to Contact Form 7 with features like:
– Minimum time-based submission detection
– Repeated submission blocker
– Multi-IP & VPN detection
– Browser fingerprint checks
– Behavior-based spam heuristics
– Admin dashboard to view spam logs & submission activity
– SweetAlert UI for user-friendly validation alerts
– Zero configuration — works immediately after activation

Features

  • Automatic protection – No need to edit CF7 forms.
  • Configurable minimum submission time (anti-bot timing)
  • Rate limiting / repeated submissions control
  • Detects VPN, proxy, and multi-IP bot patterns
  • Browser fingerprint analysis
  • Behavior-based anomaly detection
  • Centralized submission logs page
  • Lightweight, fast, no external API required

Plugin Settings

The plugin includes an easy-to-use settings panel located at
Tools → CF7 Spam Shield. Below is a quick explanation of each option:

Minimum Submission Time

Defines the minimum number of seconds a user must spend on the form before submission.
If submitted too quickly, the plugin marks it as spam.
Recommended: 3–5 seconds

Block Repeated Submissions

Prevents the same user (based on fingerprint + IP) from submitting the form multiple times within a short period.
Useful for blocking bots or users trying to flood forms.

VPN / Proxy Check

Detects whether the user is coming from a known VPN or proxy IP range.
If enabled, suspicious submissions can be blocked or flagged.

Browser Fingerprint Tracking

Captures unique browser data (OS, browser, resolution, user agent) to identify patterns and repeated spam submissions.
Fingerprint data is logged in the CF7 Spam Logs panel.

Log Viewer

A built-in dashboard where you can review all:
– Blocked submissions
– Spam reasons
– Fingerprint hashes
– IP addresses
– User agent data
– Passed submissions
Logs can be filtered by form, status, or date.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin to /wp-content/plugins/
  2. Activate it through Plugins → Installed Plugins
  3. The spam shield automatically integrates with CF7.
  4. Go to Tools → CF7 Spam Shield to customize settings.
  5. To view spam detection logs, open Tools → CF7 Spam Logs.
sections.faq:
Do I need to modify my Contact Form 7 forms?

No. The plugin works automatically. No additional tags or configuration are required.

Does this plugin store form submissions?

Only logs required for spam detection. No personal data is stored unnecessarily.

Will it slow down my site?

No. The plugin is lightweight and optimized for performance.
